FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about how Nexora ERP works as one integrated business system.

whatIs.question: What is Nexora ERP?
whatIs.answer: Nexora ERP is an integrated business management product that connects POS, inventory, customers, reporting, and multi-branch operations in one system.

included.question: Do I need to purchase separate modules?
included.answer: Nexora ERP is designed as one connected product. Core capabilities such as sales, inventory, customer management, reporting, and business operations work together inside the same system.

multiBranch.question: Can Nexora ERP manage multiple branches?
multiBranch.answer: Yes. Nexora ERP supports centralized multi-branch operations, allowing businesses to monitor branch performance, sales, inventory movement, and operational data from one place.

custom.question: Can Nexora ERP be customized for my business?
custom.answer: Custom workflows and integrations can be discussed based on your business requirements and operational needs.

try.question: How can I try Nexora ERP?
try.answer: You can request a demo or start a trial to explore how Nexora ERP can support your business operations.
